```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="cabinet_with_one_hinged_door">

  <!-- Base link: the cabinet body -->
  <link name="cabinet_body">
    <!-- Inertial properties (approximate) -->
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.79" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <!-- Mass of a typical empty cabinet of this size -->
      <mass value="30.0"/>
      <!-- Approximate inertia of a rectangular solid (width x depth x height) -->
      <inertia ixx="5.0" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="7.5" iyz="0.0"
               izz="9.0"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- Visual geometry -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.79" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.62 0.54 1.58"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="light_wood">
        <color rgba="0.8 0.7 0.5 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <!-- Collision geometry -->
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.79" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.62 0.54 1.58"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Door link -->
  <link name="cabinet_door">
    <inertial>
      <!-- Door centre is at its geometric centre; offset from hinge is handled by joint origin -->
      <origin xyz="0.155 0 0.79" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="8.0"/>
      <!-- Inertia of a thin rectangular plate (width x height x thickness≈0.02m) -->
      <inertia ixx="0.12" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.30" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.33"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.155 0 0.79" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.31 0.02 1.58"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="door_wood">
        <color rgba="0.7 0.6 0.4 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.155 0 0.79" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.31 0.02 1.58"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Revolute joint for the door -->
  <joint name="door_hinge" type="revolute">
    <!-- Hinge is on the left vertical edge of the cabinet (negative X side) -->
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="cabinet_door"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.31 0 0.79" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit effort="50.0" velocity="0.5" lower="0.0" upper="1.5708"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
